1606 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Days in months before July 1606: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30.  
From 07-15 back 184 days:  
First subtract 15 days to reach 06-30 (15 days back).  
Remaining 184 - 15 = 169 days.  
From 06-30 back 169 days:  
June: 30 days → back to 05-31 (30 days), remaining 139.  
May: 31 days → back to 04-30 (31 days), remaining 108.  
April: 30 days → back to 03-31 (30 days), remaining 78.  
March: 31 days → back to 02-28 (31 days), remaining 47.  
February: 28 days → back to 01-31 (28 days), remaining 19.  
January: back 19 days from 01-31 → 1606-01-12.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1606-01-12
